why:
The finding is real; I confirmed it in the files. The line is at theories/becoming/chapters/CIVILIZATION-THOUGHT-AND-BECOMING.md:276 (§五·五, the reasons 道 is not adopted as a name), and the find string occurs there exactly once. Three things are wrong with it.
(1) Attribution. In the frozen ZH1-S25 (sources/civilization-thought-v1.0/evidence/additions/zhuang/ZH1-S25.txt) the sentence belongs to 太公調, answering 少知's 「然則謂之道，足乎？」 in 則陽, a 杂篇 chapter. The 脉络's own metadata for ZH1-S25 (data/model.json) gives the era as 「不逐篇断为庄周亲作」 and the limits as 「人物发言…不等于作者认可每一角色」. So 「庄子自己说」 is inaccurate.
(2) The quotation is not verbatim. The frozen text has 爲 where the chapter writes 为, and the line carries no 〔ID〕. Using verify_zh's own pattern, 「道者，为之公」 does not match ZH1-S25, while the full frozen sentence does. STYLE-ZH requires 「原文」〔来源编号〕 to match the frozen text character for character.
(3) The quoted half does not support the point. The claim that 道 is only a 号 rests on the next clause, 「因其大，以號而讀之，則可也」, which is left out. passages.json (zhuang-zeyang-dao-wei-zhi-gong) and the 中华本's appendix (「则阳自言…」) both quote the full sentence and read it this way.
The replacement quotes the whole sentence in the frozen characters with 〔ZH1-S25〕 and names the speaker. I checked that it passes verify_zh's chapter-quotation pattern against ZH1-S25. I only adjusted the reviewer's wording slightly: 「答少知」 to name the setting, and 「称之」 for 「讀之」. No Lean is involved.
find: 庄子自己说「道者，为之公」，它只是一个号。
replace: 则阳篇中太公调答少知「道者，爲之公。因其大，以號而讀之，則可也」〔ZH1-S25〕：道只是因其大而称之的一个号。
